cards.text: Abram is the man God called to leave his home and go to the land of Canaan, and that's where he's living now (Genesis 12:1, 5). Then a famine hits the land, and friend, it's a SEVERE one. So Abram decides to go down to another country and live there for a while.

cards.question: The famine is severe, so Abram goes down to another country to live there for a while. Which country?

cards.text: Right as he's about to enter Egypt, Abram turns to his wife Sarai and says, “Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman…” Sounds sweet, right? Hold that thought, friend, because that is NOT where he's going with it.

cards.question: Abram tells Sarai that when the Egyptians see her, they'll say, ‘This is his wife.’ What does Abram say they'll do next?

answers.text: Kill him but let her live

cards.text: Abram's not even through the border yet, and he's already got the whole disaster worked out, start to finish. So he asks Sarai to tell people she's something else to him.

cards.question: Abram asks Sarai to say she's his ___ instead of his wife.
Abram tells Sarai that saying she's his sister will get him treated well for her sake.

cards.text: Abram walks into Egypt, and sure enough, the Egyptians see that Sarai is very beautiful. Then the officials of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, get a look at her too.

cards.question: Pharaoh's officials have seen Sarai. What do they do next?
After the officials praise her to Pharaoh, Sarai is taken into Pharaoh's ___.

cards.text: Meanwhile, Pharaoh treats Abram well on Sarai's account, just the way Abram said he'd be treated.

cards.question: While Sarai is in Pharaoh's palace, what does Abram end up with?
Sarai is Abram's wife, and she's living in Pharaoh's palace. What does the LORD do?

answers.text: Send an angel to bring Sarai out

cards.question: The LORD's severe plagues hit Pharaoh and nobody else in his household.

cards.text: Pharaoh summons Abram and asks, “What have you done to me?” I bet Abram wishes he could hide in the back of a junk drawer right now, and friend, after my years back there, I can tell you it's a GREAT hiding spot.

cards.question: Besides “What have you done to me?” what else does Pharaoh want to know from Abram?

answers.text: Why Abram didn't say Sarai was his wife
Why Abram came down to Egypt at all
Why Abram brought so many people along

cards.text: Then Pharaoh asks why Abram said she was his sister, so that Pharaoh took her as his wife. Now Pharaoh hands Sarai right back and tells Abram to take her and GO.

cards.question: When Pharaoh's men send Abram away, they make him leave his possessions behind.

cards.text: Hang on to your apron, friend, because Abram's story is only just warming up.
